gate_method: gateSense (lib/core/contentSchema.ts) imported directly and run on every row via a temporary script (scripts/.tmp-checkgate.mjs, not pushed — deleted before commit) against the full draft set, then re-verified via npm run measure:gate on the whole repo including this file — 1539 rows read from 41 batch files, 0 rejected. A one-row negative control (Latin letters + no Hebrew in translation_he, a stem with no blank, a stem leaking the answer, a duplicate distractor, only 3 scorable distractors) was run through the same checker first and correctly rejected on every one of those axes before any real row was trusted. First-draft level drift (11 of 25 rows flagged on the first pass — background words not in the NGSL-derived allow-list: deadline/thieves/diary/a-thousand/client/English+London/rope/messy/crown+palace/rang/asleep) was fixed with allow-listed replacements (grep -x verified against data/generated/allowed-words-2026-08-07.txt before re-running the real gate) and re-verified to 25/25.
distractor_allowed_words_note: Distractor words were NOT filtered against allowed-words-2026-08-07.txt (33/60 distractors in the immediately preceding batch, manifest-2026-09-16-2.json, are also outside that list) — §A1 lesson 41(c) already recorded that the NGSL-derived allowed-words pool was built for NGSL-sourced headwords and may not be the right pool now that headwords come from data/amirnet-vocab.csv (CEFR-J); a new level-appropriate distractor pool derived from the current source has not been decided or built. gateSense itself does not check distractor words against allowedWords at all (only target-word/duplicate/relation-type checks) — this remains an open, undecided gap, not a new finding.
batch_size_note: 25 rows, one sense each, full apparatus (2 examples, 3 leveled items, 4 tagged distractors) per row. T-353 — which would make sentence-less rows legal and let a tick cover many more headwords per Roy's 14/09 volume instruction — is still ⬜ (checked live in plan/50-tasks.md before choosing batch size), so CONTENT.md §STEP 5 still requires the full apparatus on every row; this tick was blocked on T-353 for the volume-only mode and wrote the full-apparatus form instead. 25 rows was sized to what this tick could hand-author, gate for real, and verify end to end inside the window, well under the 1,200-row-per-file ceiling in lib/core/spotCheck.ts.
he_one_to_many_note: None of the 25 rows needed he_one_to_many_group or he_interference_note in this batch — no genuine one-Hebrew-word-covers-several-English-senses case or documented Hebrew-speaker interference pattern applied to any of these 25 headwords, so both are null throughout rather than invented.
next_marker: next alphabetical Tier 1 single-word headword after this batch (checked live against data/amirnet-vocab.csv and all batch-*.jsonl files as of this tick) is "quit".
